messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer AcmePay (prod) is seeing intermittent signing failures and long tail latency when hitting our on-prem HSM gateway. Started ~10:10 UTC, affecting ~2% of requests, but spikes to 10% during bursts. They call it P1 because payments queue delays pile up.

maria: Short repro they sent: create session -> reuse session for 500 signs over ~5m -> after ~200-300 signs some requests return errors: `CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID` or connection reset. Also see TCP keepalive timeouts in gateway logs.

jason: Can you paste the exact client SDK + gateway config? Also need the exact error lines from the HSM proxy logs.

maria: SDK: redwood-client-js v2.4.1. Gateway: private-gw-01 (NAT timeout 300s). Log snippet: ```
2026-06-12T10:12:01 gateway: conn 10.1.4.22:52344 -> hsm:6200 keepalive expired
2026-06-12T10:12:05 hsm-proxy: ERROR signing request id=98765 err="CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID"
2026-06-12T10:12:06 hsm-proxy: INFO session 0x7f3a closed by peer
```

maria: Customer said they _didn't_ explicitly close sessions; client reuses a pool. Repro attached (small script).

kevin: :eyes: My first thought is session eviction on the HSM side (max sessions or idle GC) or intermediary TCP timeouts dropping long-lived sockets. On CloudHSM we saw similar when free sessions < threshold. Ask customer for `CKA_LABEL` usage — are they rotating keys frequently?

jason: I'll spin up the bench harness in staging and run their script with tcpdump on the gateway to check for RST/FIN. Could be idle keepalive mismatch between gateway and HSM (different keepalive intervals).

natalie: Security checklist: are keys BYOK (imported) or generated inside HSM? If keys are imported we need to confirm key attributes and that session handles aren't tied to ephemeral wrapping contexts. Also request audit log exports for the time window (we need evidence for compliance).

maria: Keys were generated in HSM per customer. I'll ask them to stream a short audit export (last 2 hours) and confirm whether they see explicit session_Close events. Also asked them to bump gateway NAT keepalive to 60s for a test.

cloudhsm-bot: Scheduled maintenance note — no maintenance windows during reported time range. (checked cluster-hsm-3)

kevin: Next steps from infra: 1) capture tcpdump on gateway during reproducer 2) reproduce with both pooled sessions and ephemeral sessions 3) check HSM firmware logs for session GC and max_sessions metrics 4) temporarily increase gateway keepalive and HSM connection timeout if possible.

jason: Doing step 1+2 now in staging, will paste results. If we see RSTs from HSM after ~5 minutes we can correlate to HSM idle timeout. If not, likely a bug in session handle reuse.

maria: Customer update sent — asked for audit export + test with keepalive bump. Marking this P1 and looping in account exec. Will post attachments when they respond. :thumbsup:
